question: Which light should you use while driving in dense fog?
explanation: Low beam lights are used when drivers are not able to see the things which are far away from them due to bad weather conditions or darkness along with this such lights are appropriate for those individuals whose speed limit is up to 25 mph.

question: Driver must change lights from high beam to low beam when following behind a vehicle within:
explanation: It is mandatory for driver to use low beam lights whenever they follow the vehicle which is behind them whose distance is within 60m that is 200 ft.

question: You should only change lanes by:
options: Blowing horn and let other drivers know that you are switching lanes.
Decreasing your speed on highway and carefully change lanes.
Giving hand signal and change lanes.
Giving proper signal, and look to make sure that lanes can be safely changed.
explanation: Drivers have to give appropriate signals before changing the lanes to make sure that it is changed safely without any risk.

question: Upon hearing siren of an emergency vehicle, what is the right thing to do according to the law?
options: Pull to the right and keep driving.
Pull to the left and keep driving.
Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the left and stop.
explanation: As per the rules of traffic law, whenever an individual hears the siren of an emergency vehicle, they have to move their vehicle to the right side and come to complete stop.

question: Which of the following documents must you produce as a vehicle owner to the on-duty police officer?
explanation: Whenever police officer who is on duty asks you for the documents you have to present your three documents which are valid driver's license, vehicle ownership certificate and insurance card of the vehicle.

question: If a car accident damage exceeds $1000, it must be reported to the police officer or when?
explanation: There are two situations when you have to report to police immediately, firstly, if a car accident occurs and damage is more than $1000, secondly, when there is personal injury.

question: When the light turns green at the intersection, who has the most priority (right-of-way) over everyone else?
options: Vehicles turning right at green light.
Vehicles turning left at green light.
Pedestrians crossing with a green light.
explanation: At intersection pedestrians have the right of way over everyone else when traffic light turns green.

question: If you are a G1 license holder, you must drive only when accompanied by:
options: G license holder with 4 years of experience.
G1 license holder with 3 years of experience.
G2 license holder with 2 years of experience.
G2 license holder with 3 years of experience.
explanation: When an individual obtains their G1 license and wants to drive they need assistance of someone who have 4 years of driving experience along with G license. Its not safe to drive alone being a new driver.

question: While the pedestrian is crossing the road and traffic signal changes, who has the right-of-way?
explanation: In a situation where the traffic light changes when pedestrians cross the road drivers have to wait until the individuals cross the road.

question: In case of an accident involving you, it should be reported to a police officer. How soon should you provide the accident report?
explanation: As per the rules of law if there is any involvement of you in the accident you have to immediately inform the police officer regarding that incident.

question: Your driver's license could be cancelled for:
explanation: There are three main reasons due to which you can lose your driver's license, First, when you didn't clear your exam in first attempt and also fail to attend another attempt. Second, when you fail to pay the reinstatement fees. Third, if you give your license to the Ministry of Transportation.

question: If an individual drives a vehicle while disqualified:
options: License suspension for half a year.
explanation: In the situation when driver is disqualifies and still caught driving the vehicle than some of the actions can take place such as for 6 months their vehicle will get impounded, they can be charged fine for $500 also gets imprisoned for 6 months. Moreover, their license will be suspended for 6 months more which will be added on their current period.

question: Default speed limit in towns, cities and villages is:
explanation: If speed limit is not posted on the boards than the maximum speed will be 50km/h in villages, cities as well as towns.

question: What should you do while facing a red light at an intersection?
explanation: At intersection if you see red light you have to stop your vehicle unless it turns green or you can proceed carefully, if the way is clear.

question: What should you do if you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?
options: Do not slow down and proceed.
explanation: When you observe a flashing yellow light at an intersection then you have to slow down the vehicle and proceed carefully when the way is clear.

question: While holding a G2 driving license, your blood alcohol level must be lower than:
explanation: As a G2 driving license holder it is mandatory that your blood alcohol level have to be 0.00%.

question: What should you do while overtaking a motorcycle (two-wheel vehicle)?
options: Overtake the motorcyclist like you overtake a car.
Blow horn to warn the motorcyclist and pass with the same lane.
Use high beam lights to alert the motorcyclist and then overtake.
explanation: You can pass the two-wheeler vehicle as you overtake the car.

question: Overdriving your vehicle headlights could be very dangerous because:
options: Speed of vehicle is very fast.
Headlights would not produce enough brightness to see clearly.
You will not be able to stop your vehicle within the distance you can see.
explanation: Driving fast founds to be risky as it's not possible for you to stop the vehicle immediately in the distance in which you can see.

question: If you had a G2 license for less than half a year and your age is less than 20, then:
options: No passengers in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
Maximum 1 passengers in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
Maximum 2 passengers in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
Maximum 3 passengers in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
explanation: As per the rules, if your age is less than 20 and also hold G2 license for less than 6 months then you are allowed to have only 1 passenger with you and their age should be 19 and you can drive between 12am to 5pm.

question: If you had a G2 license for more than half a year and your age is less than 20:
options: No passengers in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
Maximum 1 passenger in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
Maximum 2 passengers in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
Maximum 3 passengers in car with age less than 20 years between 12am and 5pm.
explanation: If you are a G2 license holder and had the license for more than 6 months then you are allowed to have 3 passengers in your car and they should be 19 and the timings for driving is between 12am to 5pm.
